narrative:
Rocky-River municipal court district has 88,856 registered voters, with 55.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 26.0%, a clear Democratic lean of 7.4 percentage points. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +9.2% D−R vs +3.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
